$comment: The personal wake verifier (T-0714): fit and lift. WakeVerifier.kt and android-app/tools/wake_verifier_test.py both follow this; WakeVerifierTest.kt carries the example verbatim.

fit.$comment: Batch gradient descent from zero on the class-balanced log loss (each class carries half), L2 on the weights, features standardised by the training set's mean and floored standard deviation.

lift.$comment: A frame the head scores at or over its level's gate is lifted to the verifier's probability when that is higher; never lowered. gate is openWakeWord's default verifier threshold and the lowest any level uses (an enrolment take under it is refused). levels are WakeSensitivity.verifierGate: on synthetic voices through the real models (scripts/verify/wake_verifier_live_check.py), 0.3 added no false fire to the head's own, 0.2 and 0.1 lifted more missed takes for a few rhymes of the name.
